pages.title: Five Kinds of Paper
pages.text: Talisman papers come in five kinds, each with its own power and its own number of uses. Fold a paper and put it in a charm slot to use it; the pages below describe what each kind does.
$(bold)Healing — 16 uses$()$(br)When you are below full health, this talisman restores 30% of your maximum health. It can trigger once every 5 seconds.
$(bold)Speed Boost — 180 uses$()$(br)While sprinting, keeps Speed II active.
$(bold)Hydrophobic — 180 uses$()$(br)When your air supply is running low, restores 40 air per tick to help you stay underwater.
$(bold)Lava Affinity — 180 uses$()$(br)When you are burning, in lava, or taking fire damage, grants Lava Affinity: faster swimming, clear vision in lava, and immunity to fire.
$(bold)Shelter — 16 uses$()$(br)Cuts down the huge hits you take, on a 5 second cooldown.
